options.query: | tstats count AS value WHERE index=*
| tstats count WHERE index=* BY sourcetype | stats dc(sourcetype) AS value

| rest /servicesNS/-/search/saved/searches splunk_server=local | search disabled=0 is_scheduled=1 | eval project_detection=if(match(title,"^(D[0-9]{2}|P1-[A-Z][0-9]{2}|OPS01)\s+-"),1,0) | where project_detection=1 | stats count AS value

index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler status=success savedsearch_name=* | eval Results=tonumber(result_count) | where Results>0 AND match(savedsearch_name,"^(D[0-9]{2}|P1-[A-Z][0-9]{2}|OPS01)\s+-") | stats count AS value
| tstats count WHERE index=* BY _time span=1h index | timechart span=1h sum(count) BY index limit=6 useother=t
| tstats count WHERE index=* BY index | sort - count | rename index AS Index count AS Events

index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler status=success savedsearch_name=* | eval Hits=tonumber(result_count) | where Hits>0 AND match(savedsearch_name,"^(D[0-9]{2}|P1-[A-Z][0-9]{2}|OPS01)\s+-") | stats sum(Hits) AS Hits BY savedsearch_name | sort - Hits | head 10 | rename savedsearch_name AS Detection

index=main (EventCode=4624 OR EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4768 OR EventCode=4769) | eval Outcome=case(EventCode=4624,"Successful logon",EventCode=4625,"Failed logon",EventCode=4768,"Kerberos TGT",EventCode=4769,"Kerberos service ticket",true(),"Other") | stats count AS Events BY Outcome | sort - Events
| tstats count WHERE index=* BY host | sort - count | head 10 | rename host AS Host count AS Events

| makeresults count=4 | streamstats count AS row | eval Playbook=case(row=1,"PB02",row=2,"PB03",row=3,"PB04",row=4,"PB05"), Scope=case(row=1,"Reconnaissance response",row=2,"Web exploitation response",row=3,"Identity response",row=4,"Persistence and C2 response"), Validation=case(row=1,"FUNCTIONALLY COMPLETE",row=2,"CP2 AND CP3 VERIFIED",row=3,"IRP2 AND IRP3 VERIFIED",row=4,"CRP1 THROUGH CRP4 VERIFIED") | table Playbook Scope Validation

| tstats latest(_time) AS Last_Event count AS Events WHERE index=* BY index sourcetype host | eval Age_Minutes=round((now()-Last_Event)/60,1), Status=case(Age_Minutes<=15,"HEALTHY",Age_Minutes<=60,"DELAYED",true(),"STALE") | convert ctime(Last_Event) | sort - Age_Minutes | table Status index sourcetype host Events Last_Event Age_Minutes | rename index AS Index sourcetype AS Sourcetype host AS Host Last_Event AS Last_Event_Time Age_Minutes AS Age_Minutes

index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler status=success savedsearch_name=* | eval Results=tonumber(result_count) | where Results>0 AND match(savedsearch_name,"^(D[0-9]{2}|P1-[A-Z][0-9]{2}|OPS01)\s+-") | table _time savedsearch_name Results run_time | rename _time AS Time savedsearch_name AS Detection run_time AS Runtime_Seconds | sort - Time | head 20
